source.sourceName: Meta Ad Library · experimental local bridge

invariants: Paid-ad intelligence is not organic virality.
Meta ad records do not independently promote a Trend Candidate or change corroboration status in Stage 04G.
Multiple ads from Meta Ad Library remain one source family for corroboration purposes.
days_running is preserved as source-native observation only; no winner, battle-tested, ROAS, CTR or performance inference is emitted.
Spend, impression and reach values remain source-native fields and are never relabelled as cross-platform views or reach.
Collection country/language/category fields from the upstream tool are collection-scope metadata and are not automatically treated as ad targeting geography or language.
No Meta scraping, Playwright, stealth, proxy rotation or rate-limit bypass logic is imported into Trend Pulse.
GitHub Actions validates the bridge with fixtures only and never scrapes Meta.
Automated-access authorization/compliance is not established; the bridge remains experimental for private learning until a fresh compliance review authorizes broader use.
